strings.seo.faqTitle: Nā nīnau i nīnau pinepine ʻia
strings.seo.faq[0].q: He mea manuahi anei ʻo pdff?
strings.seo.faq[0].a: ʻAe. He manuahi kēlā me kēia mea hana, ʻaʻohe hōʻailona wai a ʻaʻohe mea i laka ʻia ma lalo o ke kau inoa. ʻAʻole loa e noi ʻia kekahi kāleka hōʻaiʻē.
strings.seo.faq[1].q: Pono anei au i kekahi moʻokāki?
strings.seo.faq[1].a: ʻAʻole. ʻAʻohe kau inoa, ʻaʻohe helu leka uila: hoʻohana koke ʻoe i nā mea hana.
strings.seo.faq[2].q: Mālama ʻia anei koʻu mau palapala?
strings.seo.faq[2].a: ʻAʻole. Hoʻohana ʻia kāu mau faila no ka hana wale nō i noi ai ʻoe, a laila holoi ʻia. ʻAʻohe mea heluhelu iā lākou ʻaʻole hoʻi e kaʻzna ʻia.
strings.seo.faq[3].a: ʻAe. Holo ʻo pdff ma ka polokalamu kele o kēlā me kēia kelepona, papa, a kamepiula paha (Android, iPhone, Windows, Mac, Linux), me ka ʻole o ka hoʻouka ʻana i kekahi mea.
strings.seo.faq[4].q: He aha nā ʻano faila i kākoʻo ʻia?
strings.seo.faq[4].a: PDF, Word (DOCX, DOC), Excel (XLSX, XLS, CSV), PowerPoint (PPTX, PPT), OpenDocument (ODT, ODS, ODP), RTF, kiʻi (JPG, PNG, WebP, AVIF, TIFF, GIF, SVG), EPUB, TXT, HTML a me nā mea ʻē aʻe.
strings.seo.faq[5].a: Hiki iā ʻoe ke hana a hiki i {files} faila i ka manawa hoʻokahi, a ʻo ka palapala i hana ʻia hiki ke loaʻa a hiki i {pages} ʻaoʻao.
strings.privacy.title: Pilikino
strings.privacy.description: Pehea e mālama ai ʻo pdff i kāu mau faila: ʻaʻohe moʻokāki, ʻaʻohe palapala i mālama ʻia, ʻaʻohe hoʻolaha a ʻaʻohe kūʻai aku i ka ʻikepili.
strings.privacy.intro: Ua kūkulu ʻia ʻo pdff i noho nō kāu mau palapala nou. Eia, ma ka ʻōlelo maʻalahi, ka mea e hana ʻia ke hoʻohana ʻoe iā ia.
strings.privacy.sections[0].title: Kāu mau faila
strings.privacy.sections[0].text: Hoʻouna ʻia lākou me ka hoʻopaʻa ʻia (HTTPS), hana ʻia ma ke ʻano ʻakomi, a laila holoi ʻia i ka wā e mākaukau ai ka hopena. Hele nā faila nui ma o ka waihona kuikawa ma lalo o kekahi inoa pōhina a holoi ʻia i ka pau ʻana o ka hana; hoʻopau ka hoʻomaʻemaʻe ʻakomi i nā mea a pau i koe i loko o 24 hola ka lōʻihi.
strings.privacy.sections[1].title: ʻAʻohe moʻokāki, ʻaʻohe ʻikepili pilikino
strings.privacy.sections[1].text: ʻAʻole noi ʻo pdff i ke kau inoa, ka helu leka uila, ʻaʻole hoʻi i ke kāleka hōʻaiʻē. ʻAʻole loa e heluhelu ʻia, nānā ʻia, kaʻana ʻia a hoʻohana ʻia kāu mau palapala no ka hoʻ taʻahiko ʻana i ka naʻauao hana.
strings.privacy.sections[2].title: Ana kipa
strings.privacy.sections[2].text: Helu mākou i nā kipa me ka ʻike ʻole ʻia a me ka ʻole o nā kuki (Vercel Web Analytics) e ʻike ai i nā mea hana e pono ana. ʻAʻohe hoʻolaha, ʻaʻohe nānā paena keʻa.
strings.privacy.sections[3].title: Nā kuki
strings.privacy.sections[3].text: Hoʻokahi kuki wale nō, koho wale nō: hoʻomanaʻo ia i ka ʻōlelo i koho ʻia e ʻoe.
strings.privacy.sections[4].title: Hoʻipaʻa kikowaena
strings.privacy.sections[4].text: Hoʻipaʻa ʻia ka paena e Vercel ma nā kikowaena ma Palika; mālama ʻia nā hoʻololi Word, Excel a me PowerPoint e Render ma Frankfurt. Hoʻohana wale kēia mau mea hoʻolako i nā faila no ka lōʻihi o ka hoʻololi ʻana.
strings.privacy.sections[5].title: Kāhea iā mākou
strings.privacy.sections[5].text: He nīnau a manaʻo paha? E hoʻokaʻaʻike mai iā mākou mai ka ʻaoʻao papahana:

strings.tools.fusionner.seoDescription: Hui pū i nā faila PDF, Word, Excel, PowerPoint a me kiʻi i hoʻokahi PDF, ma ke ʻano āu e makemake ai. Mea manuahi, ʻaʻohe kau inoa, ʻaʻohe hōʻailona wai, holoi koke ʻia nā faila.

strings.tools.metadonnees.seoTitle: Hoʻoponopono i nā metadatos PDF (poʻo inoa, mea kākau) — manuahi
strings.tools.metadonnees.seoDescription: Hoʻololi i ke poʻo inoa, mea kākau, kumuhana a me nā huaʻōlelo kī o kekahi PDF, a holoi paha iā lākou a pau. Manuahi, pūnaewele, ʻaʻohe kau inoa.
strings.tools.metadonnees.intro: Hōʻike ke poʻo inoa ma ka pā polokalamu kele a i ʻole ka inoa mea kākau i kekahi kumu hoʻohālike kahua? Hoʻopololei i nā waiwai palapala, a i ʻole holoi iā lākou ma mua o ka kaʻana ʻana.
